title: Constitutive Atlas explicit formulation contract v0.3
description: Four executable fixed-frame profiles, including a declared dimensionless controlled-path ODE. Semantic validation additionally checks stress bindings, expression types and dimensions. No finite-rotation objectivity is implied.

url.description: Persistent clickable source URL, preferably the original publication DOI or an official author/institutional page. Retain this link in all generated catalogues and browser views.

initial.description: Illustrative values only, not implicit initialization or a preparation prescription. Temporary solve variables must be zero.

quantity.description: Source-supported physical meaning; unspecified explicitly records unresolved meaning.

increment_reset.description: Experimental legacy parent-increment reset. All finite scalar guards and triggered values read the committed parent; guard < 0 triggers simultaneous persistent-state assignments before internal integration. No event location or timed reset support.

inputs.description: Required equation-stage inputs and separate update-call context. No defaults or undeclared external fields.

solution_constraints.description: Physical solution-state constraints, separate from the residual evaluation domain. Semantic support currently requires incremental residuals.
